mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_schema_type(knowledge_base_id,kind,type_code,label,description, properties_json,status,updated_by) VALUES(#{kb},#{kind},#{typeCode},#{label},#{description},CAST(#{propertiesJson} AS JSON),#{status},#{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE label=VALUES(label),description=VALUES(description), properties_json=VALUES(properties_json),status=VALUES(status),updated_by=VALUES(updated_by), version=version+1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_schema_type WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND kind=#{kind} AND type_code=#{typeCode} AND built_in=0
mapper.select: SELECT knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,kind,type_code typeCode, label,description,properties_json propertiesJson,status,built_in builtIn,version,updated_by updatedBy, updated_time updatedTime FROM t_schema_type WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND kind=#{kind} AND type_code=#{typeCode}

SELECT knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,kind,type_code typeCode, label,description,properties_json propertiesJson,status,built_in builtIn,version,updated_by updatedBy, updated_time updatedTime FROM t_schema_type WHERE (knowledge_base_id=#{kb} OR knowledge_base_id=0) AND kind=#{kind} ORDER BY kind,built_in DESC,type_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_schema_release(release_code,knowledge_base_id,version,state, definition_json,validation_json,checksum,published_by,published_time) VALUES(#{releaseCode},#{kb},#{version},#{state},CAST(#{definitionJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{validationJson} AS JSON),#{checksum},#{publishedBy}, IF(#{state}='PUBLISHED',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,NULL))
mapper.select: SELECT release_code releaseCode,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId, version,state,definition_json definitionJson,validation_json validationJson,checksum, published_by publishedBy,published_time publishedTime,created_time createdTime FROM t_schema_release WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT release_code releaseCode, knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,version,state,definition_json definitionJson, validation_json validationJson,checksum,published_by publishedBy,published_time publishedTime FROM t_schema_release WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND state='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_schema_release SET state='ARCHIVED' WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND state='PUBLISHED'
mapper.select: SELECT entity_type typeCode,COUNT(*) useCount FROM t_entity WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} GROUP BY entity_type
SELECT relation_type typeCode,COUNT(*) useCount FROM t_relation WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} GROUP BY relation_type
SELECT type typeCode,COUNT(*) useCount FROM t_knowledge_card WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} GROUP BY type
